unresolved_mappings.title: Renal Transplantation: Indications, Immunosuppression, and Complications
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective is titled for renal/organ transplantation; nearest evidence (89-2 Chronic kidney disease) covers only the general 'collaboration with specialists'/renal-replacement-therapy management endpoint, not transplant-specific complications (rejection, immunosuppression, BK virus nephropathy) in detail.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a dedicated transplantation/immunosuppression objective; retain RECOGNIZE-level depth given patient-safety relevance of recognizing post-transplant complications. Specific immunosuppression regimen details are out of graduating-student scope (do_not_test candidate).

No MCC IDs were invented and no model-memory evidence was substituted for missing registry coverage, consistent with project accuracy rules. Also note: this chapter required unusually extensive body-heading confirmation work due to five TOC headings ('ACTOMYINS'/ACRONYMS, Acute Kidney Injury, Parenchymal Kidney Diseases [5 subtopics], Hypertension [3 subtopics], Renal Transplantation) having no toc_inventory.json node from unresolved page-anchor OCR - four of the five (all but the non-clinical acronym glossary) were confirmed via raw-OCR body-heading verification to be genuine, substantial, core-nephrology content and are represented via the UNCATALOGUED: synthetic-node-id convention (SU-NP-08, SU-NP-09 through SU-NP-12, SU-NP-15, SU-NP-19) rather than dropped as UNRESOLVED, since sufficient body evidence existed to confirm both presence and page location - see study_units.json's methodology_note and review_items.json for full detail.
